trap-nonspeakable.notes: NON-TRAP FINDING (structural, math - not fixed inline): Mechanism 2's displayed formula omits the modulus it is entirely about. '$$\mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}} = \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_\mathcal{K})).$$' is followed immediately by 'The $|\cdot|$ is the modulus.' — but no bars appear in the display, and the block's own authorNotes give the mechanism as 'm = |tr_M|'. PROPOSED: '$$\mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}} = \bigl|\mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_\mathcal{K}))\bigr|.$$'. Second item: '(b) is ruled out under the current ansatz' is a durable refutation carrying its scope only in the trailing qualifier; it reads as scope-(a) and is defensible, but the bare 'ruled out' invites the scope-(b) misreading.
